blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Tuesday said the Philippines and Poland have affirmed their readiness to commence negotiations on an extradition agreement. Currently, the two nations only have an agreement on the Transfer of Sentenced Persons, which was signed in July, but no formal extradition treaty.
